info.title: Garlic LLM API
info.summary: OpenAI-compatible chat API for Garlic LLM, running on a PlayStation 4.
info.description:
Garlic LLM runs Qwen3.5 on the PS4's own GPU. This API speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions protocol, so existing OpenAI client libraries work by changing the base URL to http://<console-address>:8080/v1.

The API is off until it is turned on with L3 on the console's chat screen, which then shows the address.

One request runs at a time; requests sent meanwhile wait their turn, up to 8 in all (more get 503). While the model answers, the console's screen says so and the conversation that was on it is cleared. Circle on the controller stops the reply: the client gets what was written so far, with finish_reason "length". A client that closes its connection ends the reply too.

The context window is 16384 tokens (GET /v1/models reports it as context_length). The messages, the tools' JSON and the reply share it. Without max_tokens the reply may use the rest of it. A request that does not fit gets 400 with the code context_length_exceeded and the numbers, worded as OpenAI words them.

Reasoning follows the console's think mode unless the request chooses: the last message may end with /think or /no_think, or the request may set chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. The reasoning comes apart from the answer, in reasoning_content.

Tools work as in OpenAI's API: tools and tool_choice in the request, tool_calls in the reply (finish_reason "tool_calls"), the results back as messages with role "tool". A streamed reply sends its text as it comes and each call whole, after the text. With stream_options.include_usage the stream ends with a chunk of usage before data: [DONE].

The console keeps what it read of the last conversation, so a request that continues it only reads its new messages.

A request body may be up to 1 MiB with up to 65536 JSON values. Parameters the console does not implement (for example logprobs, logit_bias, presence_penalty) are ignored. Only n = 1 is supported. Every answer allows any origin (CORS), so pages in a browser can call the API.

servers.description: The console on your network (its address, port 8080)

post.description: Generates the assistant's next message from the conversation. With stream: true the reply comes as server-sent events (text/event-stream), one chat.completion.chunk per piece of text, ending with data: [DONE].

200.description: The completion, or the event stream when stream is true.

schema.description: data: <chat.completion.chunk JSON>, then data: [DONE]. Each chunk is a ChatCompletionChunk.

get.description: Answers at once, also while the model is answering a request.

get.summary: Check that the server is up, and whether it is busy

busy.description: A request sent now would wait: one is being answered, or the console itself uses the model (a chat reply, the keyboard, voice mode, dictation, a Python program).

waiting.description: Chat requests in line, besides the one being answered.

bearerAuth.description: Only when the console has an API key (the file /data/garlic_api_key.txt). Without one, no key is needed.

Role.description: developer is read as system. Any other role is read as user.

content.description: Text, or an array of parts whose text parts are joined (other parts, such as images, are left out). An assistant message with tool_calls may have no content, or null.

tool_calls.description: An assistant message's calls, as the API sent them. Each needs a function name.

tool_call_id.description: A tool message: the call it answers.

reasoning_content.description: An assistant message's reasoning, as the API sent it (kept only in a run of tool calls, as Qwen's chat template does).

parameters.description: A JSON Schema of the arguments. Arguments whose type is not string come back as JSON values.

id.description: Unique to the reply, e.g. call_6929a1b31_1.

model.description: Accepted and ignored: the console runs the one model it has (see GET /v1/models).

max_tokens.description: Tokens of the answer; the reasoning has its own limit (1024 by default). Without it the answer may use the rest of the context window.

max_completion_tokens.description: Same as max_tokens; it wins when both are given.

include_usage.description: The stream ends with one more chunk before data: [DONE], with no choices and the usage of the whole reply.

enable_thinking.description: true: the model reasons before it answers; false: it answers at once. Without it the console's think mode decides.

reasoning_effort.description: "none" or "minimal": no reasoning; any other value: reasoning. Used when enable_thinking is not given.

tools.description: Their JSON takes part of the context window, as Qwen's chat template writes them in the system message, and counts in usage.prompt_tokens.

tool_choice.description: "auto" (the default with tools), "none", "required", or one function: {"type": "function", "function": {"name": ...}}, which must be one of the tools. With "required" or a function the reply begins with a call and does not reason.

parallel_tool_calls.description: false: at most one call per reply (the first the model writes).

prompt_tokens.description: The messages and the tools, as the model reads them.

completion_tokens.description: The answer's tokens and the reasoning's.

content.description: null when the reply is only tool calls.

reasoning_content.description: The reasoning before the answer, when the model reasoned.

choices.description: One choice; empty in the usage chunk (stream_options.include_usage).

reasoning_content.description: A piece of the reasoning; these come before the answer's.

tool_calls.description: One whole call per chunk, after the text.

usage.description: Only in the last chunk, with stream_options.include_usage.

context_length.description: The context window in tokens: the messages, the tools and the reply together.

message.description: What is wrong, in a sentence.

code.description: invalid_body (the body is not valid JSON, not an object, has more than 65536 values, or a field is wrong), context_length_exceeded (the request does not fit the context window), invalid_api_key (401), request_too_large (413: the body is over 1 MiB), model_not_found (404), busy (503: 8 requests are already waiting).
